name: Mubert
summary: AI music generator producing royalty-free tracks for videos, podcasts and apps, with an API.
description: Mubert generates royalty-free music from text prompts, moods and durations for video, podcasts and apps, and offers an API for developers and a podcast editor called Cast. A free non-commercial plan includes limited generations. Paid plans start with Creator at $14 per month ($11.69 billed annually), and commercial-use plans start at $39 per month ($32.49 annually). Commercial plans cover freelance and agency work as well as use in apps and services.

howToUse.title: Open Mubert
howToUse.description: Open Mubert and sign up, then choose Mubert Render to generate a track.

howToUse.title: Set a prompt, mood and duration
howToUse.description: Enter a text prompt and set moods and durations so Mubert generates royalty-free music that fits a video, a podcast or an app.

howToUse.title: Use the API or the Cast editor
howToUse.description: Developers can request the API to bring music into apps and services. For podcasts, open the podcast editor called Cast.

howToUse.title: Match the plan to the use
howToUse.description: A free non-commercial plan includes limited generations. Creator starts at $14 per month ($11.69 billed annually), and commercial plans, from $39 per month ($32.49 annually), cover freelance and agency work.
